assets.name: Old Bicycle
assets.description: A single old black bicycle from the 1950s seen from the side, whole bicycle inside the frame. Two plain black circles for the wheels with EXACTLY EIGHT plain straight spokes each and no more, one plain black diamond-shaped frame, one plain straight handlebar bar across the front, one plain flat saddle, and behind the saddle ONE plain flat rectangular luggage rack over the back wheel, drawn large enough for a person to sit on. No chain links, no gears, no cables, no brand lettering, no reflectors, no basket, no bell.
assets.notes: LỖI THỜI — thay bằng 'Old Bicycle V2'. Mô tả gốc QUÊN HẲN BÀN ĐẠP: liệt kê khung/bánh/ghi-đông/yên/yên sau nhưng không có pedal, nên ảnh ra xe không có bàn đạp — trong khi cả 5 cảnh đều viết 'hai chân đạp bàn đạp'. (Ghi chú cũ: Yên sau (luggage rack) là chi tiết BẮT BUỘC — cảnh chốt của case là hồn Chu Tú Hoa ngồi trên đó. Dáng xe theo refs/case-5/13-bicycle-*.jpg (Flying Pigeon, đúng dòng xe phổ biến thời đó).)

assets.name: Wooden Fishing Boat
assets.description: A single old wooden fishing boat seen from the side, floating level, whole boat inside the frame. One plain curved hull shape in flat mid-brown with a plain darker band along its top edge, one plain small square wheelhouse box near the middle with EXACTLY ONE plain square window, and one plain straight mast pole rising from the deck with no sail and no rigging. No planking lines, no wood grain, no ropes, no nets, no lettering, no water drawn around it.

assets.name: Small Refugee Boat
assets.description: A single small open wooden boat seen from the side, floating level, with no cabin and no mast at all. One plain shallow curved hull shape in flat pale brown with a plain darker band along its top edge, and EXACTLY THREE plain flat bench planks laid across it and no more. No planking lines, no wood grain, no oars, no ropes, no lettering, no water drawn around it.

Người dùng xem 2 vòng sửa cảnh 'Adrift At Sea' và chỉ ra vấn đề gốc không phải tư thế mà là THÂN THUYỀN QUÁ NÔNG ('shallow curved hull') — mạn thuyền thấp hơn hẳn vai người ngồi, nên ai cũng như ngồi ĐÈ LÊN TRÊN thuyền chứ không lọt vào TRONG. Thuyền tị nạn rời Kim Môn. Cố ý KHÁC hẳn 'Wooden Fishing Boat' (không cabin, không cột buồm, thân nông) để 2 thuyền đứng cạnh nhau trong 1 khung là phân biệt được ngay.

assets.name: Pair Of Ancestral Tablets
assets.description: Two plain upright wooden ancestral tablets standing side by side on one plain low wooden stand. Each tablet is one plain tall rounded-top rectangle in flat dark red-brown with one plain narrow gold border line inside its edge, and the flat panel inside that border is completely BLANK — absolutely no writing, no letters, no characters and no carving on either tablet anywhere. One plain small brass incense bowl sits in front of them on the same stand, holding EXACTLY TWO plain thin straight incense sticks and no more, with no smoke drawn.
assets.notes: Cảnh chốt của case (khắc CẢ HAI tên). Bài vị để TRỐNG TRƠN có chủ đích — model viết chữ Hán ra ký tự vô nghĩa; chữ thật người dùng thêm lúc dựng. Tham khảo refs/case-5/19-real-people-02/03.jpg và 12-ancestral-tablet-*.jpg.

assets.name: Folded Newspaper
assets.description: A single folded newspaper lying flat, seen from above. One plain pale grey rectangle folded once across the middle, with EXACTLY FOUR plain thin horizontal grey lines on the upper half standing for columns of text and nothing more — absolutely no readable letters, no characters, no headlines, no photographs and no images inside it.

assets.name: Village Sanheyuan Exterior
assets.description: The front of a traditional Taiwanese single-storey courtyard farmhouse in the 1950s, seen straight on. Built from horizontal bands stacked top to bottom: a plain pale blue sky band across the top; a plain dark grey tiled roof band with its ridge line perfectly horizontal; a plain red-brown brick front wall filling the middle, carrying EXACTLY ONE tall plain open central doorway at the centre and EXACTLY ONE plain square window on each side of it and no more; and a plain flat pale grey packed-earth courtyard strip running edge to edge across the bottom. Each window is one flat dark shape crossed by exactly two thin pale white diagonal streak shapes so it plainly reads as glass. The house wall must be scaled and positioned to completely fill the frame from the far left edge to the far right edge, with absolutely no gap of open ground or empty sky at either side edge. Standing against the wall at one side is EXACTLY ONE plain large clay water jar and nothing else. The courtyard strip across the bottom third stays clear and completely empty. Draw NO individual bricks, NO brick courses, NO roof tiles, NO wood grain and NO ornament of any kind. Muted palette of red-brown, dark grey and pale blue in a few flat tints. Plain flat daylight, daytime.
assets.notes: Nhà tam hợp viện, tham khảo refs/case-5/06-sanheyuan-*.jpg. Cố ý CẤM vẽ từng viên gạch và từng viên ngói — đó là hai thứ mái ngói kiểu Hoa dễ ra hàng trăm chi tiết nhất.

assets.name: Village Bedroom
assets.description: A small plain bedroom in a Taiwanese village house in the 1950s, seen straight on. Built from horizontal bands stacked top to bottom: a plain pale cream ceiling band across the top, a plain pale cream plaster back wall filling the middle, and a plain flat grey packed-earth floor strip running edge to edge across the bottom. Standing against the back wall in the RIGHT half of the frame is one plain low wooden bed seen from the side, drawn as ONE plain flat mattress slab with ONE plain flat thin blanket shape over it and nothing else on it — no springs, no slats, no pattern, no pillow detail. Beside it stands one plain small square wooden stool with nothing on it. The bed and the stool rest directly ON the floor strip and must touch it, not float. Set in the back wall in the LEFT half is EXACTLY ONE plain square window with EXACTLY FOUR plain straight wooden bars across it and no more, filled with one flat pale blue shape. The floor strip is ONE single flat shape with absolutely NO floorboards, NO tiles and NO grid, and the whole left half of it stays clear and completely empty so a person can stand there. Draw NO wood grain and NO plaster texture anywhere. Muted palette of pale cream, grey and dark brown in a few flat tints. Plain flat indoor daylight, daytime.

assets.name: Main Hall With Coffin
assets.description: The main hall of a Taiwanese village house in the 1950s, laid out for a funeral. The room is built from exactly TWO flat wall planes meeting along ONE single vertical corner line: the LEFT panel fills roughly the left third and is the SIDE WALL, drawn in a slightly DARKER flat tint of the same pale cream; the RIGHT panel is the BACK WALL in the lighter tint. Exactly one straight diagonal line runs from the foot of the vertical corner line down toward the bottom-left corner, so the floor reads as turning at the corner. There are no other diagonal lines, no vanishing point and no rows of tiles shrinking toward a distance. On the BACK WALL hangs EXACTLY ONE plain dark wooden altar shelf carrying EXACTLY TWO plain unlit candle shapes and one plain small incense bowl, and nothing else at all on either wall. Standing on the floor in the middle of the room, set at a slight angle so both its long side and one end are visible, is ONE plain heavy wooden coffin: a plain long six-sided box in flat dark red-brown with one plain darker flat lid band along its whole top edge, its lid OPEN and leaning against the near side, and no carving, no cloth, no flowers and no lettering on it. The coffin rests on two plain low wooden trestles and must touch them. The floor is ONE single flat grey shape with absolutely NO floorboards, NO tiles and NO grid, and the near floor across the bottom third of the frame is left clear and completely empty. Draw NO wood grain, NO plaster texture and NO ornament anywhere. Sombre palette of pale cream, dark red-brown and grey in a few flat tints. Plain flat indoor daylight, daytime.
assets.notes: LỖI THỜI — thay bằng 'Main Hall With Coffin V2'. Người dùng xem ảnh và yêu cầu đặt quan tài NẰM NGANG thay vì chéo. (Ghi chú cũ: Background DUY NHẤT của case dùng composition 'corner', theo luật skill mục 6h: có nhân vật TÁC ĐỘNG LÊN VẬT — Lâm ngồi bật dậy TỪ TRONG quan tài, Ngô cúi xuống bên quan tài. Nền phẳng chiếu thẳng thì quan tài chỉ đọc ra là cái hộp đứng trước mặt, không đọc ra người đang ở trong. Quan tài vẽ THẲNG vào background (không tách Prop) vì chỉ xuất hiện ở đúng bối cảnh này — skill mục 7.)

assets.name: Country Road Rice Fields
assets.description: An open stretch of Taiwanese farmland in the 1950s seen straight on from the edge of a dirt road. Built from horizontal bands stacked top to bottom: a plain pale blue sky band across the top; a low row of plain dark green hills all at the same height along the horizon; a wide band of plain flat green rice paddy running edge to edge, divided by EXACTLY THREE plain straight horizontal water lines and no more — no individual rice plants, no stalks, no reflections; and a plain flat tan dirt road strip running edge to edge across the bottom. Standing where the paddy band meets the road are EXACTLY FOUR plain thin utility poles evenly spaced across the frame and no more, each drawn as one straight vertical line with ONE short crossbar near the top, each one rising from the road strip and plainly touching it, passing IN FRONT OF the paddy band. assets.name: Military Hospital Clinic Room
assets.description: A plain military hospital consulting room in Taiwan in the 1950s, seen straight on. Built from horizontal bands stacked top to bottom: a plain white ceiling band across the top, a plain pale mint-green painted wall filling the middle, and a plain flat pale grey floor strip running edge to edge across the bottom. Standing against the wall in the RIGHT half of the frame is one plain wooden desk seen from the side, drawn as ONE plain flat rectangular front panel with EXACTLY ONE plain drawer front and no more, with nothing on top of it except EXACTLY ONE plain closed folder shape; one plain wooden chair stands beside it. Against the wall in the LEFT half stands one plain narrow examination bed drawn as ONE plain flat slab on four plain straight legs, with nothing on it. Everything rests directly ON the floor strip and must touch it. Set in the wall between them is EXACTLY ONE plain tall rectangular window filled with one flat pale blue shape crossed by exactly two thin pale white diagonal streak shapes so it plainly reads as glass, and nothing else at all on the wall — no posters, no charts, no clock. The floor strip is ONE single flat shape with absolutely NO tiles, NO grid and NO pattern, and the middle of it stays clear and completely empty. Clean palette of pale mint-green, white and pale grey in a few flat tints. Plain flat indoor daylight, daytime.

assets.name: Kinmen Shore Daytime
assets.description: A bare stretch of shoreline on a small island off the Chinese coast in 1958, seen straight on. Built from horizontal bands stacked top to bottom: a plain pale grey overcast sky band across the top; a low row of plain single-storey stone houses with plain dark grey pitched roofs standing side by side along the far edge, all at exactly the same height and scaled to completely fill the frame from the far left edge to the far right edge with no gap of sky or ground at either side; a plain flat dark blue-green sea band; and a plain flat pale sand strip running edge to edge across the bottom. The houses rest directly ON the sea band's far edge and must touch it, not float. Draw NO individual stones, NO brick courses, NO roof tiles, NO waves, NO foam and NO reflections — the sea is ONE single flat shape. The sand strip across the bottom third stays clear and completely empty. Muted palette of pale grey, dark blue-green and pale sand in a few flat tints. Plain flat overcast daylight, daytime.
assets.notes: LỖI THỜI — thay bằng 'Kinmen Shore Daytime V2'. SAI THỨ TỰ DẢI: mô tả xếp dải biển ở GIỮA, giữa dãy nhà và bãi cát, nên nhà nằm phía sau mặt nước và chân nhà bị mép dải biển cắt ngang — đúng lỗi 'vật đứng bị cắt cụt ở ranh giới dải' của RUNBOOK 8.1.3h. Câu 'nhà tựa lên mép xa của dải biển' càng làm model đặt nhà đứng trên mặt nước.

assets.name: Open Sea Daytime
assets.description: The open sea far from land, seen straight on with no shore anywhere. Built from horizontal bands stacked top to bottom: a plain pale blue sky band filling the upper half, with EXACTLY TWO plain flat white cloud shapes and no more; one single perfectly straight horizontal horizon line running unbroken from the far left edge to the far right edge; and a plain flat deep blue-green sea filling the lower half, drawn as ONE single flat shape crossed by EXACTLY THREE plain thin darker horizontal lines evenly spaced and NOTHING MORE — no waves, no foam, no crests, no ripples, no sparkle and no reflections. There is no land, no boat, no bird and no object of any kind anywhere in the picture. Calm palette of pale blue and deep blue-green in a few flat tints. Plain flat daylight, daytime.

assets.name: Temple Interior

assets.name: Funeral Hall With Altar

Built from horizontal bands stacked top to bottom: a plain white ceiling band across the top; a plain pale yellow cloth back wall filling the middle, hung with EXACTLY ONE plain wide white cloth banner across its upper part, completely BLANK with absolutely no writing, no letters, no characters and no pattern on it; one plain long low table standing against that wall, covered by ONE plain flat white cloth shape reaching the floor, with nothing on top of it at all; and a plain flat grey floor strip running edge to edge across the bottom. On each side of the table stands EXACTLY ONE plain tall white funeral flower stand, drawn as one plain straight pole with ONE plain round white flower mass on top and no petals, no leaves and no detail. Each house must be drawn COMPLETE from its roof ridge all the way down to its footing, and its walls must rest directly on the pale sand strip and plainly touch it: no band edge may cut across any house, and no house may stand in the water or float. The row of houses must be scaled and positioned to completely fill the frame from the far left edge to the far right edge, with no gap of open sky or bare sand at either side edge. The sea band across the bottom third is left completely clear and empty, with NO waves, NO foam, NO ripples and NO reflections — one single flat shape, ready for a small boat to be placed on it. assets.notes: Sửa thứ tự dải: trời → nhà → BÃI CÁT (nhà đứng trên đó) → BIỂN ở dải dưới cùng, gần người xem nhất, là chỗ đặt chiếc thuyền. Bài học: thứ tự dải mã hoá KHOẢNG CÁCH (trên = xa nhất), nên dải mà nhân vật đứng/nổi trên phải là dải DƯỚI CÙNG. Thêm câu cấm mọi mép dải cắt ngang thân nhà (RUNBOOK 8.1.3h).

assets.notes: Sửa lỗi 'nhìn như 2 quan tài' — bỏ hẳn nắp khỏi khung thay vì tìm cách đặt nó chỗ khác, vì bất kỳ khối gỗ sẫm màu nào đứng gần quan tài chính đều có nguy cơ bị đọc nhầm thành quan tài thứ hai. Câu 'ONLY ONE coffin-like shape' nói tường minh số lượng, đúng bài học RA SỐ CỤ THỂ.

assets.name: Main Hall With Mourners V3
assets.description: Use the single reference image and keep absolutely everything in it unchanged — the same two wall panels meeting at the same vertical corner line, the same altar shelf with its two candles and incense bowl, the same single coffin lying square across the picture with its top and bottom edges perfectly horizontal and open at the top, the same two trestles, the same floor, the same colours, and the same flat 2D style with bold uniform-width black outlines and completely flat colour fills, no shading and no gradients. Change ONLY this: add EXACTLY THREE plain standing people in plain dark clothes along the BACK WALL behind the coffin, all facing toward the coffin. Draw each of them turned about forty-five degrees to one side, with EXACTLY TWO small round black dots for the eyes and ONE short straight line for the mouth, no nose and no eyebrows. Draw their arms and legs as THIN PLAIN STRAIGHT LINES with no thickness at all, with no hands, no fingers, no feet and no shoes, and draw the clothing of each one as ONE plain flat dark shape with no folds, no creases and no buttons. Vary their heights slightly and give them different flat hair colours so they do not look like copies of one figure. They must stay small, stay entirely BEHIND the coffin against the back wall — the near floor in front of the coffin stays clear and completely empty. Add nothing else at all, and do not add any second coffin-like shape anywhere. Everything else stays exactly as it already is.

assets.name: Small Refugee Boat V2
assets.description: A single small open wooden boat seen from the side, floating level, with no cabin and no mast at all, whole boat inside the frame. The hull is DEEP, not shallow: its sides rise high from the waterline — deep enough that a seated adult person placed inside the boat would be hidden from the waist down by the hull walls, with only their head, shoulders and upper chest showing above the top edge of the boat. The hull is ONE plain curved shape in flat pale brown with a plain darker band along its top edge, and EXACTLY THREE plain flat bench planks laid across it low down inside the hull, well below the top edge, and no more. No planking lines, no wood grain, no oars, no ropes, no lettering, no water drawn around it.
assets.notes: LỖI THỜI — thay bằng 'Small Refugee Boat V3'. Người dùng đề xuất hướng khác hẳn sau 3 vòng sửa không dứt điểm (chồm mép mũi, thân quá nông): bỏ hẳn việc vẽ CHIỀU SÂU khoang thuyền — chỉ vẽ THÀNH THUYỀN như một dải phẳng, người đứng ngay sau dải đó với thân dưới bị chính dải che theo kiểu lớp phẳng (Z-order 2D), không cần model tính đúng tỉ lệ 3D nào cả. Viết MỚI HOÀN TOÀN bằng chữ, KHÔNG dùng editFrom — đổi độ sâu thân thuyền là đổi hình dạng cơ bản, và editFrom neo vào ảnh cũ (thành nông) rất dễ bị 'ảnh thắng chữ' kéo ngược lại, đúng bài học RUNBOOK mục 4.12. Chốt bằng tỉ lệ đo được: 'người ngồi bị che từ thắt lưng trở xuống, chỉ thấy đầu/vai/phần trên ngực' — không nói chung chung 'sâu hơn'.

assets.name: Small Refugee Boat V3
assets.description: A single small wooden boat seen from the side, drawn LONGER than usual — about twice the length of an ordinary rowing boat — so several people can stand side by side along it. Draw ONLY the boat's outer hull as ONE single flat curved shape in pale brown: a gently curved bottom edge, and ONE single straight top edge running almost the full length of the hull — this top edge is the boat's rim, drawn at roughly waist height on a standing adult figure. The boat's INTERIOR IS NOT SHOWN AT ALL: no floor, no benches, no seats, no ribs and nothing visible above the rim — the hull reads as ONE simple flat shape, like a long low wall or a counter, not as a container with visible depth inside it. One plain darker band runs along the top rim to give it a little thickness. No cabin, no mast, no oars, no ropes, no lettering, no planking lines, no wood grain.
assets.notes: Thiết kế lại hoàn toàn bằng chữ (không editFrom — đây là đổi Ý TƯỞNG hình dạng, không phải sửa chi tiết). Thuyền chỉ còn 1 dải cong = thành thuyền, không vẽ nội thất. Kéo dài gấp đôi bình thường để đủ chỗ 4 người xếp hàng dọc theo mép. Cách ghép người vào xem ở 3 cảnh dùng nó.

assets.name: Fishing Boat Deck
assets.description: The open wooden deck of a fishing boat in 1958, seen straight on from on board. Built from horizontal bands stacked top to bottom: a plain pale blue sky band across the top; a plain small square wheelhouse box standing at the back of the deck with EXACTLY ONE plain square window in it and no more; a plain flat wooden deck floor filling the middle and running edge to edge; and along the very bottom edge, one plain low wooden rail running edge to edge at roughly waist height, with a narrow strip of flat dark blue-green sea just visible beyond it. Standing at one side of the deck are EXACTLY ONE coiled rope shape, drawn as one plain flat spiral, and EXACTLY ONE plain wooden crate, and nothing else — no nets, no barrels, no other fishing gear. The middle of the deck floor stays clear and empty, reserved for people to stand on. Draw NO planking lines, NO wood grain and NO texture of any kind. Muted palette of pale wood tan, dark grey and pale blue in a few flat tints. Plain flat daylight, daytime.
assets.notes: Background MỚI theo yêu cầu người dùng — CỐ Ý không dùng Prop 'Wooden Fishing Boat' làm reference (nó chỉ vẽ toàn bộ thân thuyền nhìn từ xa, không đủ không gian sàn để đặt nhiều nhân vật). Đây là cảnh DUY NHẤT nhìn từ TRÊN boong tàu, khác hẳn góc nhìn 'từ ngoài nhìn vào' của mọi cảnh thuyền khác trong case — nên tách hẳn thành Background riêng, không editFrom.

assets.name: Police Constable
assets.description: a man in his thirties wearing a plain khaki police uniform shirt with two plain chest pockets as his one and only garment, no cap and no hat at all, thick black hair parted low on one side and combed flat across the forehead, clean-shaven with no beard and no moustache but with long thick black sideburns running down to the earlobes
assets.notes: Cảnh sát THỨ HAI, thêm 2026-08-16 cho đoạn ra khơi chỉ chỗ + bắt thuyền: kịch bản nói 'investigators'/'police' số nhiều, mà cả case mới có 1 asset cảnh sát. Theo skill mục 5d (vai phụ xuất hiện từ 2 cảnh trở lên PHẢI có Character asset) — anh này có mặt ở 3 cảnh nên tả-trong-prompt sẽ ra 3 người khác nhau. Cùng áo khaki 2 túi ngực với 'Police Investigator' để đọc ra cùng lực lượng; phân biệt theo mục 5a bằng ĐẦU TRẦN + tóc rẽ ngôi thấp chải bẹt + tóc mai dài (Police Investigator: đội mũ kê-pi, tóc ngắn, cạo nhẵn; Military Officer: mũ kê-pi, tóc hoa râm, ria đen).

assets.name: Police Patrol Boat
assets.description: A single small police patrol launch seen from the side, floating level, whole boat inside the frame. One plain long low hull shape in flat pale grey with a plain dark navy band along its top edge, the bow end drawn a little higher than the stern end. Standing on the deck is ONE plain long low cabin box in flat white, about half the length of the boat and set slightly toward the bow, with EXACTLY THREE plain square windows in a row along its side and no more. At the stern end stands EXACTLY ONE plain thin short flagpole carrying ONE small plain flat dark navy rectangular flag, and that flag is completely BLANK — absolutely no emblem, no star, no sun, no symbol, no letters and no writing on it anywhere. The boat has NO mast, NO sail, NO rigging, NO net, NO rope, NO life ring, NO railing and NO portholes. No planking lines, no wood grain, no lettering or numbers anywhere on the hull, and no water drawn around it.
assets.notes: Prop MỚI 2026-08-16 — thuyền của chính quyền chở nhân vật ra biển. Cố ý ĐỐI LẬP từng điểm với Prop 'Wooden Fishing Boat' để cắt cảnh là phân biệt được ngay: thân xám nhạt + viền navy (thuyền cá: nâu gỗ + viền nâu đậm), cabin dài thấp 3 cửa sổ (thuyền cá: hộp vuông nhỏ 1 cửa sổ), KHÔNG cột buồm (thuyền cá: 1 cột buồm cao). Cờ để TRỐNG theo skill mục 6i — cờ Trung Hoa Dân Quốc có mặt trời 12 tia, model vẽ ra sẽ thành hoa văn bậy. Tham khảo refs/case-5/35-police-boat-01.jpg (tàu tuần tra cảnh sát bằng gỗ, 1964) và -04.jpg (tàu cảnh sát cảng Cơ Long).

assets.name: Police Boat Deck
assets.description: The open deck of a small police patrol launch out at sea in 1959, seen straight on from on board. Built from horizontal bands stacked top to bottom: a plain pale blue sky band across the top; a plain long low white cabin box standing at the back of the deck and running most of the width, with EXACTLY THREE plain square windows in a row in it and no more, and EXACTLY ONE plain doorway rectangle at one end of it; a plain flat pale grey deck floor filling the middle and running edge to edge; and along the very bottom edge, one plain low metal rail running edge to edge at roughly waist height, drawn as ONE plain horizontal top bar carried on EXACTLY FOUR plain thin vertical posts and NOTHING MORE — no extra bars, no netting, no chain — with a narrow strip of flat deep blue-green sea just visible beyond it. The rail STOPS at the deck floor; in front of it the near deck is left completely clear across the whole width. Hanging on the front of the cabin at one side is EXACTLY ONE plain round life ring, drawn as one flat white circle with one flat orange ring inside it, and nothing else at all — no nets, no crates, no barrels, no coils of rope, no fishing gear of any kind. The middle of the deck floor stays clear and empty, reserved for people to stand on. Draw NO planking lines, NO wood grain, NO texture, and NO lettering, NO numbers and NO writing of any kind anywhere. Muted palette of pale grey, white, dark navy and pale blue in a few flat tints. Plain flat daylight, daytime.
assets.notes: Background MỚI 2026-08-16 — boong tàu cảnh sát nhìn từ trên tàu, cặp đôi với 'Fishing Boat Deck' (cùng kiểu dựng dải ngang: trời → cabin → sàn → lan can + dải biển) để 2 cảnh boong tàu trong cùng đoạn đọc ra cùng một ngôn ngữ dựng. Phân biệt bằng CHẤT LIỆU: sàn xám kim loại + cabin trắng dài 3 cửa sổ + phao cứu sinh (thuyền cá: sàn gỗ tan + hộp lái vuông 1 cửa sổ + cuộn thừng + thùng gỗ). CỐ Ý không dùng Prop 'Police Patrol Boat' làm reference — prop đó vẽ cả con thuyền nhìn từ ngoài, không có sàn để đặt người, đúng lý do đã ghi ở 'Fishing Boat Deck'. Tham khảo refs/case-5/35-police-boat-02.jpg (3 cảnh sát đứng trên boong trước, lan can thấp chắn ngang mép dưới).
